name: megalluksi

scripts.build: node scripts/bundle-migrations.mjs --check && prisma generate && next build
scripts.preview: opennextjs-cloudflare build && node scripts/patch-open-next.mjs && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.deploy: opennextjs-cloudflare build && node scripts/patch-open-next.mjs && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy

description: MegaLLuksi — free-entry QR giveaway platform with publicly verifiable draws (drand).

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Free option: create a project at [neon.tech](https://neon.tech), copy the **pooled** connection string (it ends with `?sslmode=require`).

SESSION_SECRET.description: Random secret (at least 32 characters) used to sign sessions and tokens. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 48` or a password manager. Never share it.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: One-time password for the first-run page `/setup`, where you create the admin account. Use any random string of 12+ characters.

APP_URL.description: Public address of the site, used in QR codes and e-mails. Keep `https://megalluksi.win` and add it under **Settings → Domains & Routes** after deploying.
